name: return_duct_paramid
title: Return duct reference model for parameter identification
summary: Reference return-duct model in three connected components (Colebrook pressure drop, leakage with infiltration/exfiltration and water/energy balances, epsilon-NTU heat gain) plus the normalized ratios of the parametric study from which the simplified model CSL-0170 was fitted.

origin.course: ULiège model bank, return duct reference model for the parametric study of the simplified duct model, 2008-03-17

verification.summary: Against the stored solution of Return_Duct_ParamID_EES_Model_JL080317.EES (107 decoded records plus 7 backslash-named ones decoded by hand from the binary): 114 common variables, 19 differ (rtol=0.001), only in EES: 0, only in CoolSolve: 0. Maximum relative difference 7.29e-03 on Re_leakage_duct_02.
verification.reference: EES stored solution in Return_Duct_ParamID_EES_Model_JL080317.EES (ees_variables.csv + 7 hand-decoded backslash records)
verification.notes: All 19 differences above rtol=1e-3 trace to the humid-air viscosity of EES 7.888 differing from CoolProp by 0.60% (mu_duct_01 1.8229e-05 vs 1.8120e-05 Pa.s; specific volume 3.75e-04), propagated through Re -> zeta_leakage -> C_leakage -> M_dot_leakage (1.31e-03) -> DELTAp_duct (1.41e-03). Thermal results agree: t_ex_duct 1.5e-04, W_ex_duct 1.4e-04, Q_dot_duct_03 5e-04 relative. Pressure falls along the duct, ambient air infiltrates (M_dot_leakage_duct negative), outlet state between supply and ambient. 18 Diagram-window inputs/parameters restored as equations with the values of the stored run; no equation of the original changed.
